features.quote: Turn cap: 40 agent turns or 250k tokens, whichever first.
features.justification_quote: Pilots suggest most spirals onset by turn 15–25; 40 gives headroom without runaway cost.

features.quote: cap runs once a spiral is confirmed and keep the scenario framing neutral rather than adding berating users or punitive feedback to juice trigger rates… given genuine uncertainty about whether sustained distress-like states in models matter morally, there's no reason to make runs longer or harsher than the measurement requires.
